text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kinpai is a special race that brings 
good fortune. Tamamo Cross felt 
particularly strongly about it, making 
this entry a long-cherished dream come 
true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And a brilliant victory was claimed! In 
the New Year at Kyoto, she brought good 
fortune to her fans as well.
